create_RemoteAgent: create a RemoteAgent wrapping an existing Salina agent to execute it in a separate process
call_RemoteAgent: call a RemoteAgent with a shared workspace to run the agent forward pass in another process
create_NRemoteAgent: create an NRemoteAgent with multiple process copies of an agent using the NRemoteAgent.create factory method
toggle_train_eval_RemoteAgent: toggle a RemoteAgent between train and eval mode by sending commands to its subprocess
close_NRemoteAgent: close an NRemoteAgent to terminate all child RemoteAgent subprocesses and clean up IPC queues
